Artifical Intelligence

Filed under: #pinned

I did not use generative AI at all in the making of this website (including code, art, and writing). I prefer to be bad at things in a human way.

Unfortunately, AI's forced onto me daily by virtue of being on the internet. I feel like this is hell, or humanity is headed straight there. Sometimes I think I've done something terrible in a past life, and that's why the world sucks.
